Hello! Your art style is so incredible. Would you be willing to draw my original characters?

They exist in a world where supernatural creatures come from a "Blue Fog". These supernatural creatures, known as "outsiders," often take human-like characteristics and tendencies. To combat these creatures, humans develop the ability to control "sin" in different ways. These humans are called "exorcists." Additionally, some humans create pacts with outsiders and sign away their humanity in exchange for power. These humans are called "demons." Both demons and exorcists are capable of defeating outsiders. 

❓🌅 RELATIONSHIP: They are siblings, born into an affluent and well-known exorcist family. Their parents are extremely stern strict, and duty-bound. Both siblings grow under the auspice of their parents' strict teachings and are expected to train diligently to become excellent exorcists like their parents. Although they live in a suffocating household that is devoid of warmth, the siblings are extremely close. To Sycamore (older brother), his younger sister is someone he wants to protect the smile of from the minute she is born. To Willow (younger sister), her older brother is someone she wants to teach how to be selfish. 

In present day, Willow is deceased, and it has been eight years since her passing. 

❓ SYCAMORE | 188CM | 38 YEARS OLD | BROTHER
› A doctor by trade. 
› He is 30 years old when his younger sister's life is taken by an outsider. 
› He has heterochromia. His right eye is red, and his left eye is green.
› He has two beauty marks. He has one beauty mark under each of his eyes.
› Before Willow's passing, he does not have any scars and does not wear a choker or need bandages. He acquires the scar over his right eye after Willow passes. He inflicts this scar on himself to mimic a wound that Willow had at death in the same place.
› After Willow's death, he begins using his ability recklessly. He only wears black and white. He begins sporting a large variety of wounds and bruises, constantly. He has a scar around his neck, over his eyes, and in various other places. 
› Before Willow's death, he was very calm, collected, and composed. An extremely gentle person. Very refined. Smart and sharp. He was obedient to his parents and was his sister's voice of reason. Still, he spoiled her and often played along with her whims so long as they weren't dangerous to her. 
› After Willow's death, he becomes much less serious. He is still calm and serene, but he is also childish. Silly and overly lighthearted. He acts like a careless, reckless, fool who doesn't take anything seriously because he does not want anyone to put their trust in him. He grows so jaded by the losses of his loved ones that he becomes apathetic on the inside, but pretends to be warm-hearted on the outside because he does not think he deserves the concern and care of others. He pretends to be friendly and kind because he does not think he deserves to grieve.
› As an exorcist, Sycamore has the unique ability to transfer someone else's wounds onto himself. It requires he inflict a similar wound on himself before he transfers the other person's. 
› MOTIFS: Gingko leaves. Autumn days. Operating room table. Shattered glass.

🌅 WILLOW | 165CM | 25 YEARS OLD (AT DEATH) | SISTER
› She is 25 years old at the time of her death. She is killed in action while working as an exorcist. An outsider manages to take her life. 
› Her blonde hair is the same as her brother's, but Willow's gets lighter toward the ends. She always wore it in a loose braid.
› Bright green eyes. 
› One beauty mark beneath her left eye.
› Willow was always upbeat, energetic, and charismatic. She was bold and confident, and had a passion for life. Willow was not shy in the slightest, and extremely friendly. She was the "sun" to her brother's "moon." Where her brother was the voice of reason, Willow was the one who made sure they were both living life to the fullest. 
› She was the type of person who embodied the "hero" stereotype and truly believed that her life, however precious it may be to her, was never more precious than someone who needed her help.
› Someone who was always laughing and smiling. She was a very emotional, human, person, who did not keep secrets. She wore her heart on her sleeve and had trouble hiding her emotions.
› At the time of her death, both of her parents were already dead and had died in action while working as exorcists as well. Although she maintained her strong personality, in the last year of Willow's life, she was desperately trying to "fill her parents' shoes." 
› As an exorcist, Willow had the unique ability to use her blood to create constructs and shields. It required she inflict a wound on herself to shed blood in the first place. 
› MOTIFS: Goldenrod. Firecrackers. Summer days. Strawberry ice cream. 

Please feel free to draw them in any composition or pose, and in any outfits you see fit. Please feel free to reject this request for any reason whatsoever. Thank you so much for your time and consideration!

シナリオは、超自然的生物が「青い霧」からやってくる世界。登場人物は2人とも、怪物を駆除する同じ民間警備会社で働いている。   

1.ガイスト｜183cm｜40
元刑事。モノの記憶を読み取る能力を持つ。年齢は40歳。その能力のため、いつも手袋をしている。甘いお菓子と焼き菓子が大好き！  

性格は優しく、物わかりがよく、そつがない。その裏では、計算高く、人を操ることもある。大人でクールであろうとするが、おバカなこともしばしば。   

モチーフ：冬、雪、氷。  

2.スミン｜178cm｜38
高級将校。双子の妹を含め、多くの戦友の死を背負っている。妹が死んだのは自分のせいだと思っている。   生きたいとは思わないが、自分が死ねば彼女の犠牲を無駄にすることになると理解している。その代わり、「面白いこと」や「興味深いこと」を見つけようと、どこか無目的に日々を過ごしている。   

キツネのように愛嬌があり、外見的な性格で自然と人を惹きつける。非常に気まぐれだが、同時に抜け目がなく、他人を自分の個人的な目標にとって有益か有害かのどちらかとしか見ていない。他人から離れたり見捨てたりすることに何の問題もない。孤独な人間だが、それが人生の必然だと自分を納得させている。   

モチーフ：夜の海。見捨てられた寺院。夏の夜。線香花火。   

スミンはガイストが欲しがっている情報にアクセスできる。その情報は多くの困難を乗り越えて得たものだからだ。ガイストが一貫してスミンを追いかけるのは、スミンが世界の真実を見つけるという目的を達成する手助けをしてくれると信じているからだ。スミンは狡猾で、情報を得ようとするガイストの試みを台無しにし続ける。スミンは一貫してガイストが嫌がることをする。例えば、顔に煙を吹きかけたり、ガイストが入る前にタクシーのドアを閉めたり。しかし、ガイストはそんなスミンの行動にもかかわらず、とてもしつこい。   

もしよろしければ、この画像を将来的に個人的な印刷に使いたいのですが（販売、商用利用、大量生産は不可）。また、レイヤーを分離した.psdでファイルをいただけますか？ありがとうございます。何か問題があれば遠慮なくお断りください！細部の作り直しや衣装の変更もお気軽にどうぞ！

REN】170cm

バニース】170cm

先生、こんにちは！この2人のキャラクターを描いていただけませんか？］私はあなたが最近作ったキャラクターのページがとても好きです！

1.シリカ【177cm、46歳
シリカは戦士の女王。威厳があり、力強く、自惚れが強い。常に自分の思い通りにすることに慣れていて、権力に酔っている。シリカは今にも襲いかかろうとする蛇のようで、危険だが落ち着いている。何があっても人や物を支配し、所有したいという欲求がある。彼女は反抗的な精神で成長し、力への飽くなき渇望を持っている。金色のアイシャドーを施した蛇のような瞳にご注目！普段は半眼である。

モチーフ：金色の蛇、砕けた鏡、爪、繊細な剣とレイピア、騎士、ステンドグラス、首輪の手！！献身的なものなら何でも...（彼女にとっては！）。

2.インナ【177センチ、45歳
